properties.summary: Forty acres, an existing 1,800-square-foot mobile home, a 30x60 barn, reported high-and-dry usable land, and a recent $55,000 price cut make this a strong operational base rather than raw dirt. The big question is whether Madison County will support Joe's intended commercial use and whether the existing infrastructure can be reused economically.

confirmed: Current listing price is $295,000 after a $55,000 reduction from $350,000.
The parcel is 40.02 acres in Madison County, about six miles from I-10 according to the listing.
A 1,800-square-foot manufactured home and 30x60 barn are reported onsite.
The listing reports a well, county-road frontage and high-and-dry usable acreage.
The manufactured home is tenant occupied and the broker states it needs extensive work.
unknowns: What exact zoning and future-land-use designations apply to parcel 24-2S-10-1473-004-000?
Can an RV park, campground, cabins, events or other revenue-producing uses be approved here?
What septic system exists and what commercial wastewater capacity is feasible?
Are the barn, home, well, septic and electrical improvements permitted and reusable?
How much of the advertised high-and-dry claim survives FEMA, wetlands, soils and drainage review?
dealKillers: County land-use rules block the intended revenue model.
Wastewater limitations prevent a viable site count.
Existing improvements require enough remediation that their head start disappears.
Flood, wetlands, access or road conditions materially reduce usable acreage or guest access.
nextActions: Pull Madison County GIS, zoning, future land use, FEMA flood, wetlands and soils for parcel 24-2S-10-1473-004-000.
Ask Madison County planning for the written approval path for campground/RV/cabin/event uses on this parcel.
Verify permits and condition for the home, 30x60 barn, well, septic and electrical service, including tenant status and possession at closing.
